messages:
alex: Opening a new support case for GPU quota in our new GCP org/project (eu-west1). Need 16 A100 GPUs regional quota + increase in regional internal IPs and ephemeral external IPs. Case opened: 123456789012345.

maria: Thanks — can you drop the project id and org id and expected timeline? I’ll inventory current quotas.

alex: project_id: redwood-eu-prod-2026, org: org-987654321. Timeline: want initial 16 A100s within 2 weeks, eventual ceiling 64 GPUs across region.

ryan: Also requested increase for "In-use IPs" quota (for load balancers) and routes per VPC. GCP often blocks LB IPs early.

paula: tagging finance — need a quick cost ballpark for 16 non-preemptible A100s sustained so we can approve PO.

paula: quick estimate: ~USD 70k-85k/month depending on sustained hours. I’ll put a formal number in the PO.

oncall-bot: checklist: ensure billing enabled and Compute Engine API is on: 
`gcloud services enable compute.googleapis.com --project=redwood-eu-prod-2026`

maria: Copy of GCP reply pasted into case: "Case 123456789012345 updated — Quota request reviewed. Please confirm sustained usage pattern and attach any PO or purchase order. ETA for response: 2 business days."

alex: Sent usage plan and attached PO stub. I requested the quota be set as REGIONAL A100 (not per-zone).

ryan: For networking they asked for VPC topology and peered networks. I uploaded `vpc-topology-diagram.pdf` to the case and included subnet ranges.

maria: GCP just escalated to Capacity Ops. New internal ref: 123456789012345-ESCL. They asked for provisioning timeline — we said 7–10 business days after PO.

alex: Can we prioritize eu-west1 for this initial batch? APAC follow-up next quarter. Also need confirmation on GPU image families and whether preemptible quotas are separate.

paula: Finance note: project needs label `cost_center=infra-redwood` for chargeback. Confirmed.

oncall-bot: reminder: create RT ticket in infra tracker so SRE can follow provisioning progress: https://rt.internal/INC-2026-0457

maria: Small gotcha from support: enable Service Networking API for private services access: 
`gcloud services enable servicenetworking.googleapis.com --project=redwood-eu-prod-2026`

ryan: If they issue zonal quotas instead of regional, we should request quotas in 3 zones (eu-west1-b/c/d) to reduce AZ contention. Noted in case.

alex: Update from GCP case: "Capacity Ops approved 12 A100 regional quota, 4 remaining under review. Provisioning window: 5–7 business days after PO receipt."

paula: PO has been signed and submitted. Finance will monitor billing impact. Do we wait for full 16 before scheduling infra work?

maria: Marking thread as "pending-provision" in our rollout board. Hold scheduling until full quota confirmed; we can start infra prep now (images, init scripts).

ryan: Next action: if Capacity Ops stalls beyond ETA, escalate via partner channel. Partner contact: partner-team@gcp-partners.example.com (saved in runbook).

alex: Thanks all — I’ll update when status changes to "Quota Applied". If GCP returns only zonal quotas we’ll reconvene and adjust topology. :thumbsup:
